decisions.reason: A coupling protection cap is a low-cost accessory with negligible carrying cost, so keeping the option open while demand resolves is cheap.
The box car trailer series is featured on the home page and fits the core business, and one year is too short for its uncertainty to resolve, so the option still has value.
The car transporter is a niche product presented only on its own page, but it shares production with the core range, so carrying it costs little while its prospects remain uncertain.
The low-bed series is prominently promoted and core to the hauling range, and there is no evidence yet that its value will not be realized.
The high trailer cover series is a home-page product built on existing platforms, giving it a low carrying cost and unresolved upside.
This second box car series partly overlaps with B, which raises the chance of consolidation, but its home-page presence and low incremental cost favor keeping it for now.
